title: Extreme adjectives: huge, tiny, wonderful
grammarNote: ОБЫЧНЫЕ прилагательные описывают качество по шкале (big, cold, good). КРАЙНИЕ (extreme) прилагательные уже содержат идею "очень" — они выражают максимальную степень. Для обычных прилагательных мы говорим "very big", но для крайних — нельзя сказать "very enormous". Вместо "very" используют "absolutely", "completely", "totally".

grammarTable.subject: big
grammarTable.example: The saiga herd is enormous. The steppe is absolutely massive.

grammarTable.subject: small
grammarTable.example: The pygmy jerboa is tiny. The mouse is absolutely minute.

grammarTable.subject: cold
grammarTable.example: It's absolutely freezing in the Altai in winter.

grammarTable.subject: hot
grammarTable.example: The Kyzylkum Desert is scorching in summer.

grammarTable.subject: bad
grammarTable.example: The pollution is completely terrible for wildlife.

grammarTable.subject: tired
grammarTable.example: After the hike I was absolutely exhausted.

grammarTable.subject: surprised
grammarTable.example: I was totally amazed by the saiga migration.

rows.example: very big ✅ · very cold ✅ · very good ✅ · very tired ✅
absolutely enormous ✅ · absolutely freezing ✅ · absolutely wonderful ✅
completely exhausted ✅ · completely silent ✅ · completely wrong ✅
totally amazed ✅ · totally different ✅ · totally destroyed ✅
❌ very enormous → ✅ absolutely enormous / just enormous
❌ absolutely big → ✅ absolutely enormous (use the extreme!)

grammarExtra.title: Full list of extreme adjective pairs

rows.example: The whale is absolutely enormous — the biggest animal on Earth.
The pygmy jerboa has a totally tiny body but huge ears!
It was absolutely freezing — minus forty! I couldn't feel my feet.
The desert was completely scorching — over 45 degrees!
The documentary was absolutely wonderful — a masterpiece.
The air quality near the factory is totally awful.
The river was absolutely filthy — black with industrial waste.
The mountain air was completely pristine — crystal clear.
After the trek I was totally exhausted — I slept for 12 hours.
I was absolutely terrified when the eagle flew past my head.
I was completely amazed by the saiga migration — I couldn't speak.
The steppe at night was absolutely silent — not a sound.
✅ absolutely enormous / just enormous.
✅ absolutely freezing / completely freezing.
✅ very big / absolutely huge (use the extreme version!).
"unique" = extreme (only one of its kind) → absolutely unique ✅.

grammarTip:
Два типа прилагательных — разные правила:

① ОБЫЧНЫЕ (gradable): big, cold, good, tired, bad
   → Используй: very / quite / rather + adj
   very big · quite cold · rather bad

② КРАЙНИЕ (non-gradable/extreme): huge, freezing, wonderful, exhausted, terrible
   → Используй: absolutely / completely / totally + adj
   absolutely enormous · completely exhausted · totally wonderful
   → НЕ используй: very enormous / very freezing ❌

💡 Парочки для запоминания:
big ↔ huge/enormous · cold ↔ freezing · good ↔ wonderful
bad ↔ terrible · tired ↔ exhausted · surprised ↔ amazed

exercises.text: The saiga herd was ___ — there must have been a million animals!
The temperature in the Altai in winter is ___ freezing.

exercises.instruction: Write the extreme version of the adjective.
exercises.text: The steppe at night is not just quiet — it's ___ (extremely quiet).
After the long hike up the mountain, I was ___ .
exercises.hint: "exhausted" is the extreme version of "tired" → absolutely exhausted ✅.
"very" + extreme adjective is wrong. ✅ "It was absolutely freezing."

exercises.text: The desert in summer is not just hot — it's ___ (extreme: very hot).
exercises.hint: hot → boiling / scorching / baking (all correct). The desert is scorching.

exercises.instruction: Which intensifier is correct with extreme adjectives?
exercises.text: The pollution in the river was ___ awful.
The Caspian seal's eyes are ___ (= very beautiful).
"The elephant is very enormous" is correct English.
exercises.hint: "enormous" is already extreme → "absolutely enormous" or just "enormous". Never "very enormous".

exercises.instruction: What is the extreme version of "small"?
exercises.text: The pygmy jerboa is not just small — it is ___.
exercises.hint: The extreme version of "small" is "tiny" or "minute". Then: absolutely tiny ✅.

exercises.instruction: Complete: "I was ___ when I saw the saiga herd."
exercises.text: "I was ___ when I saw the saiga herd." (= completely surprised)
exercises.hint: "amazed" = extreme version of "surprised" → completely amazed ✅. Not "absolutely surprised".

questions.text: Which is the correct extreme version of "cold"?

questions.hint: "enormous" is extreme → absolutely enormous. Never "very enormous".

questions.text: What is the extreme version of "good"?
questions.hint: good → wonderful, fantastic, superb, magnificent (extreme versions).
bad → terrible, awful, dreadful, appalling (extreme versions).

questions.text: "I was ___ amazed by the saiga herd." — which intensifier?
The desert in summer is ___ ___ . (extreme: extremely hot)

questions.hint: small → tiny / minute (extreme). Then: absolutely tiny ✅.

questions.text: Which intensifier is used with BOTH normal and extreme adjectives?
questions.hint: "quite" is flexible: quite big (normal) AND quite extraordinary (extreme). Very = normal only.

questions.text: The pristine mountain air is ___ clean (extreme).
"I was completely ___ by the snow leopard." (extreme version of surprised)

questions.hint: "enormous" is already extreme → cannot use "very enormous". Use "absolutely enormous".
